cards.title: Second Baby? You've Forgotten Everything
cards.body: New parent discovers she's forgotten basics like feeding and sleep routines after having a second child. Her mum's practical help and memories of her own carefree childhood provide unexpected comfort during the chaos.

cards.title: Should You Let AI Parent Your Kids?
cards.body: Tech companies now offer eye-movement trackers, personalized podcasts, and optimized nap predictions for parents. The question remains: who actually needs these tools, and what are we outsourcing?

cards.title: The '18 Summers' Parenting Trend Problem
cards.body: The viral '18 summers' trend pushes parents to optimize every school holiday for memory-making. Long, unstructured days are actually the whole point of summer freedom.

cards.title: Anxiety Passes From Parent to Child
cards.body: Your anxiety patterns could be teaching your child to be anxious too. Small changes in how you respond to fear can break the cycle and build your child's confidence.

cards.title: The Back-to-School Parent Trap
cards.body: Parents carry emotional weight beyond school supplies, desperately wanting their children to feel they belong. Back-to-school season tests parental anxieties as much as student readiness.

cards.title: Postpartum Psychosis: Hidden Warning Signs
cards.body: Postpartum psychosis often hides behind anxiety, insomnia, and depression symptoms. Recognizing its shifting signs can be lifesaving for new mothers.

cards.title: When Adult Children's Crises Consume You
cards.body: Parents can deeply love adult children without living in permanent crisis mode. Breaking emotional standby requires setting healthy boundaries.

cards.title: Childbirth Culture Needs to Evolve
cards.body: Healthcare professionals and mothers share experiences of feeling 'othered' by idealized childbirth narratives. The culture surrounding 'ideal' labour needs broader, more compassionate perspectives.

cards.title: Children in Temporary Housing Hit Record High
cards.body: The number of children living in temporary accommodation has reached its 18th consecutive quarterly high. Families report the emotional and practical toll of housing instability.
